contract_or_sow_accepted_gate.rule: All predicates remain independent. Evidence satisfying one may be referenced by another only where explicitly applicable; no state promotion is transitive.
contract_or_sow_accepted_gate.execution_boundary: Even a future CONTRACT_OR_SOW_ACCEPTED evidence disposition does not itself mutate StegBusiness/StegBusiness-Ops to EXECUTED; contract execution remains its own owner-governed transition.

source_semantics.hydrasafe: Facility SOW acceptance/deliverable acceptance does not mean regulatory approval, engineering certification or operational authorization; external professional work remains separately governed.
source_semantics.gp10: Written exact scope and fee/cost-plus amount are required before accepting payment; the service does not establish legal approval or operational authority.
source_semantics.icv_proposal_envelope: Acceptance instructions do not determine legal sufficiency or counterpart authority.
